name: Negapoji ~Onii-chan to Yobanaide!!~
original_name: ねがぽじ～お兄ちゃんと呼ばないでっ！！～
source:
Hiroba Mahiru, the protagonist, is a girl attending Mizuki Academy. One day in the changing rooms at school, Mahiru's friend Kasumi Sakuraba accidentally tore off her panties. After what she saw, Kasumi declared Mahiru was a boy. After this, Mahiru was forced to go to the hospital for two months, before finally being able to return to school...

...but as a boy instead.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ねがぽじ_〜お兄ちゃんと呼ばないでっ!!〜]Japanese Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
主人公广场真昼是水月学园的一名女生。一天在学校更衣室里，朋友樱庭香澄不小心扯破了真昼的内裤。看到眼前情形后，香澄断言真昼其实是男生。此后，真昼被迫住院两个月，终于得以重返学校…

…但这次是以男生的身份。

[翻译自[url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ねがぽじ_〜お兄ちゃんと呼ばないでっ!!〜]日文Wikipedia[/url]]
